ingredientSections.heading: Rosemary Butter
items: ½ Cup Butter at room temperature

methodSections.heading: Cilantro Walnut Pesto
steps: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender, blend until smooth and set aside.

methodSections.heading: Rosemary Butter
steps: Remove the rosemary leaves from the stalks and toast in pan until slightly browned and scent has started to come out. Place all ingredients in a stand-mixer and whip until butter has almost doubled in volume. Place in fridge if using at a later time.

methodSections.heading: Beef Tenderloin
steps: Rub the steaks with salt and pepper and set aside to bring to room temperature. Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Remove the fibrous ends from asparagus, rinse and set aside.
Cut the creamer potatoes in half and toss in olive oil. Place on greased roasting pan and in the oven 180°C (350°F) for 30 minutes or until crispy on outside and soft inside.

Heat a sauté pan on medium to medium-high heat adding 1 tablespoon butter and steaks. Flip the steaks every minute or so until desired doneness is reached. Rest the steaks for 3-4 minutes to let juices settle.

It is recommended to use a probing thermometer for accurate doneness. Take steaks off heat 3-5 degrees below desired doneness as steaks will continue cooking while resting. Rare – 50°C (125F), Medium rare – 57°C (135F), Medium – 63°C (145F), Medium well – 66°C (150F), Well – 71°C (160F)
Heat a large sauté pan adding butter and the asparagus and cook until slightly softened. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Toss the potatoes in the rosemary butter and add more Parmesan on top if desired.
Serve steaks with asparagus, potatoes and cilantro walnut pesto.
